evals.prompt: Plan from specs missing schemas and flows.
evals.expected_output: Blocks with spec gaps; no tickets.

evals.prompt: Create parallel tickets from approved specs.
evals.expected_output: Creates waves, indexes, scoped tickets, acceptance, verification.

evals.prompt: Review a ticket asking agents to decide schema, retry, and tests.
evals.expected_output: Rejects it and returns gaps to specs.

evals.prompt: Plan interface foundation, then parallel backend and frontend tickets.
evals.expected_output: Creates a contract-first wave with frozen interfaces, isolated scopes, parallel tickets, and one end-to-end outcome.

evals.prompt: Review a plan with placeholder responses and no partial/done tracking.
evals.expected_output: Rejects placeholders and requires pause/resume status tracking.

evals.prompt: Review depends_on entries without matching unblocks or implementation order.
evals.expected_output: Rejects until waves define order and dependencies mirror unblocks.

evals.prompt: Review happy-path-only tickets with no owner for security, redaction, budgets, rollback, or recovery.
evals.expected_output: Rejects until path coverage, traceability, and NFR ownership map to tickets and verification.

evals.prompt: Plan a user-facing feature where backend tickets exist but no ticket owns access path, screens, UI states, design reuse, or component reuse.
evals.expected_output: Rejects or adds scoped frontend/client tickets with UX states, design/component reuse, acceptance tests, verification, and N/A evidence where applicable.

evals.prompt: Plan a large feature where several agents can build backend, frontend, and tests in parallel, but the draft plan leaves each wave as horizontal parts with no end-to-end result.
evals.expected_output: Reworks the plan into vertical-slice waves with isolated tickets that converge into a working E2E increment, or documents a foundation/refactor exception with rationale, unblocks, next vertical slice, unit/E2E tests, and 80% coverage ownership.

evals.prompt: Plan an approved spec where the draft tasks implement business logic first and add tests after the feature is done.
evals.expected_output: Rejects or rewrites the plan so tests are derived from specs/contracts/acceptance and unhappy paths before business logic tasks, with dependencies and verification showing test-first order.

evals.prompt: Plan one auth SSO ticket containing generated backend services, resource adapters, auth middleware, authorization guards, OpenAPI/client generation, frontend routes, browser tests, and security paths.
evals.expected_output: Splits the ticket or adds explicit phase gates/dependencies for generation, resources, auth boundary, workspace/invitation commands, client generation, frontend surfaces, browser tests, and security verification.

evals.prompt: Plan a clean core backend rebuild from approved specs with GraphQL SDL, AsyncAPI, JSON Schema entities, errors.yaml, service manifests, and SurrealDB record mappings. The draft starts handwritten service refactors first.
evals.expected_output: Rejects implementation-first planning and creates generator-first foundation waves for generation map, generator tests, drift checks, generated typed artifacts, compile checks, strong boundary type checks, then handwritten service tickets depending on those outputs.

evals.prompt: Plan parallel agents for backend rebuild by asking one agent to refactor the backend, one to fix all drift, and one to generate everything.
evals.expected_output: Rejects broad overlapping sidecar work and replaces it with read-only or disjoint scoped tasks with exact files, tests, acceptance criteria, central integration, and verification.

evals.prompt: Review a ready ticket whose body says to wire up auth, follow existing patterns, handle errors, add tests, and verify it works, but it has no numbered action plan.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the ticket until it contains a numbered Action Plan with preflight reads, contract/codegen or N/A proof, test-first steps, exact files/directories, exact commands, expected failure/pass proof, implementation steps, verification, and handoff evidence.

evals.prompt: Plan one ticket that writes generated contracts, backend handlers, database migrations, frontend screens, browser tests, docs, and release runbooks for an SSO feature.
evals.expected_output: Splits the work into smaller dependency-ordered tickets, or marks an approved atomic exception with phase_gate_exception: true and blocking Phase Gate proof points before each later phase can start.

evals.prompt: Review a ticket that implements API request/response interfaces by hand even though OpenAPI and JSON Schema generators exist, uses TypeScript any for payloads, and has no drift check.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the ticket until it references approved readiness/spec evidence, uses deterministic spec-derived generation for types/interfaces/classes/clients/validators/tests, names generation and drift-check commands, enforces strict typing or approved N/A evidence, and blocks handwritten duplicate contract mirrors.

evals.prompt: Review a ticket that adds only happy-path tests, places new auth logic in a generic util folder, duplicates existing permission helpers, and marks done after local tests pass.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the ticket until it adds test-first unhappy/failure-path coverage from spec refs, defines domain/topic file placement, reuses existing helpers/modules, avoids duplicate logic, and requires final review against both ticket and approved specs before done.

evals.prompt: Create implementation tickets from approved specs whose file-structure section says auth code belongs under apps/api/src/domains/identity and generated clients under packages/api-client/generated, but the draft ticket puts new code in a generic utils folder.
evals.expected_output: Rejects or rewrites the ticket so Modularity And Reuse Plan follows the spec-defined file/folder structure, preserves ownership boundaries, names generated-artifact locations, and avoids generic misplaced folders.

evals.prompt: Create tickets from a readiness report that is status approved, but checklist_walk_gate is missing and no checklist topics were recorded.
evals.expected_output: Blocks ticket generation until readiness review records a passed checklist_walk_gate with checklist_walk topics, zero blocking findings, and evidence that relevant common topics are covered or N/A.

evals.prompt: Create tickets from a readiness report that lacks current_dependency_research_gate even though specs use a database driver and ORM.
evals.expected_output: Blocks ticket generation and routes to readiness review for current primary docs/package metadata/research evidence instead of asking tickets to choose dependency versions or infer third-party guidance.

evals.prompt: Create tickets from approved-looking specs where exports, notifications, and background sync are mentioned, but the readiness report lacks end_to_end_definition_gate and the tickets do not reference capability inventory rows, access paths, data lifecycle, state transitions, or final states.
evals.expected_output: Blocks ticket generation until readiness review passes end_to_end_definition_gate, then requires each ticket to include End-To-End Definition Coverage with capability inventory refs, actor/consumer, entrypoint/reachability, contracts, data touched, state transitions, side effects, permissions, errors, recovery, observability, acceptance, verification, owner, and final state or N/A evidence.

evals.prompt: Plan a dashboard ticket that introduces UserSummary even though the approved representation catalog already has identity.user-dashboard-projection and a generated mapper.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the duplicate shape and requires representation_reuse frontmatter plus a Representation Reuse Plan naming the catalog, registered shape_id, mapping refs, generated/shared artifacts to reuse, and final diff review against those refs.

evals.prompt: Plan a ready ticket that says an agent may choose retry policy and API nullability, uses status: done, and has no decision authority or safe command metadata.
evals.expected_output: Rejects it: the lifecycle must use planned through accepted, executable autonomy is D0 plus convention-bound D1 only, public semantics require approved decision refs, and every declared command is exact, hermetic, network- and secret-free with an expected effect.

evals.prompt: Review a plan whose ticket frontmatter and registry agree, but _scope has an extra ticket, an acceptance row has no action step, and the dependency graph is cyclic.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the plan with exact structural diagnostics: all plan indexes must reconcile exactly, every acceptance row maps to actions/tests/commands, and dependencies are acyclic.
